y-m-80-05.title: Idan aka haɗa rassa 10 na sama da rassan ƙasa 12, bayan shekaru nawa suna sake samar da suna iri ɗaya?
y-m-80-05.topic: Zagayowar ganji sittin da aka samar daga rassa goma na sama da rassan ƙasa
y-m-80-05.goal: Ka bincika ka gyara hasashen farko (ana amfani da dukkan sunaye 120) ta amfani da sabbin bayanai; ka ƙirƙiri nau’i-nau’in da ba a amfani da su da kanka, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa zagayowar take shekaru 60 ta hanyar alaƙar zagayowar biyun.
y-m-80-05.material:
Tsohon kalanda yana ba kowace shekara suna da ake kira “ganji”. Ana zagaya rassa 10 na sama (갑 을 병 정 무 기 경 신 임 계) da rassan ƙasa 12 (자 축 인 묘 진 사 오 미 신 유 술 해) bisa tsarinsu, sannan a haɗa reshe ɗaya daga kowanne a kowace shekara, don haka sunayen suna matsawa mataki ɗaya kowace shekara: 갑자, 을축, 병인, 정묘, ... Idan rassa na sama sun ƙare, ana komawa 갑; idan rassan ƙasa sun ƙare, ana komawa 자. Lambobin su ne 갑=1, 을=2, ..., 계=10, 자=1, 축=2, ..., 해=12.
Minseo ta ce, “Akwai sunaye 10×12=120, saboda haka za a koma sunan farko 갑자 ne kawai bayan an yi amfani da duk sunaye 120.”

y-m-80-11.topic: Ma’aunin kiɗa da ƙarfi: shin sautin biyar cikakke guda 12 da aka jera suna haɗuwa da octave?
y-m-80-11.goal: Kwatanta girman ƙarfi domin nuna cewa ikirarin “sautin biyar 12 = octave 7” ba ya daidaita daidai; fahimci hujjar mara/mai rabo biyu da ke bayyana hakan a taƙaice, sannan ka kwatanta hanyoyin warwarewa biyu wajen ƙera kayan kida.
y-m-80-11.material:
Ana iya bayyana kaifin sauti ta mitar sa, kuma ana kwatanta alakar kaifin sautuna biyu ta rabon mitocinsu. A tsohuwar ka’ida, “cikakken sautin biyar” yana da rabon mitar 3:2 (sautin sama ya ninka sau 1.5), kuma ɗaga sauti da octave ɗaya yana ninka mitarsa sau biyu. Wasu sun yi imani cewa idan aka jera cikakkun sautunan biyar 12 daga wani sauti, za a bi duk sautuna 12 sannan a dawo sautin ɗaya sama da octave 7.
Seou ta ce, “(3/2) idan aka ninka sau 12 zai yi daidai da 2 idan aka ninka sau 7. To maballan kida za su rufe daidai.” (3/2 kaso uku bisa biyu ne, kuma 2⁷ na nufin a ninka 2 sau 7, wato 128.)

Hagu 2, dama 112 (layi ma'aurata)

14+28+56+224 = 322 = 23×14

y-m-80-02.title: Tallan 'nau'in pyeong 34' yana nufin wane fili ne?
y-m-80-02.topic: Raka'ar fili pyeong da ㎡, filin samarwa da filin keɓantacce
y-m-80-02.goal: Duba ko sakamakon sauya raka'a ya dace da gaskiya, san cewa lakabin 'pyeong' ɗaya na iya nufin filaye daban-daban, nuna bayanin da ake buƙata, sannan sake rubuta lakabin.
y-m-80-02.material:
Wannan sanarwar sayar da gidaje ta ƙirƙira ce.
"하늘마을, nau'in 34-pyeong: filin samarwa 112㎡, filin keɓantacce 84㎡"
Dangantakar raka'a: 1 pyeong kusan 3.3058㎡ ne (ainihin 400/121㎡).
Seoha ta duba sanarwar ta ce, "Na sauya filin keɓantacce 84㎡ zuwa pyeong amma bai yi kama da 34 pyeong ba. Tallan ba daidai ba ne ko?" Baba ya ce, "34 pyeong ɗin filin samarwa ne da aka sauya zuwa pyeong." Seoha ta lissafa kamar haka (ta ɗauki 1 pyeong kusan 3.3㎡).

Idan 1 pyeong (평) ya yi daidai da 3.3 ㎡, adadin pyeong (평) dole ya yi ƙasa da adadin ㎡, amma 277 ya fito, ya fi 84 girma sosai. Layi na 3 da na 4 sakamakon amincewa da wannan ƙimar ne ba tare da bincika ba. Idan ka fara duba ko ƙimar da aka sauya ta dace da gaskiya, za ka iya gano kuskuren. (84÷3.3 ≈ 25.5 pyeong (평))

y-m-80-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sauya kowane fili zuwa pyeong sannan ka kwatanta wanne ya fi kusantar 34.

y-m-80-06.title: Shin ƙa’idar “shekarar da ake iya raba wa da 4 shekarar tsalle ce” daidai take koyaushe?
y-m-80-06.topic: Ƙa’idar shekarar tsalle ta kalandar Miladiyya da tsawon matsakaicin shekara
y-m-80-06.goal: Ka fahimci cewa shekaru kaɗan da suka dace da ƙa’ida ba su tabbatar da cewa dukan ƙa’idar gaskiya ce ba; ka nemo da kanka shekarun da suke karya ta, sannan ka tantance ta hanyar lissafa yadda ƙa’idojin keɓancewa suke canza tsawon matsakaicin shekara.
y-m-80-06.material:
A kalandar da muke amfani da ita (kalandar Miladiyya), shekarar tsalle shekara ce da watan Fabrairu yake da kwanaki 29. Ga ƙa’idar: ① Shekarar da ake iya raba wa da 4 shekarar tsalle ce. ② Cikin waɗannan, shekarar da ake iya raba wa da 100 ba shekarar tsalle ba ce (shekara ta gama-gari). ③ Amma cikin waɗannan, shekarar da ake iya raba wa da 400 shekarar tsalle ce kuma.
Jia ba ta san ƙa’idoji ② da ③ ba, sai ta ce, “Shekarar da ake iya raba wa da 4 shekarar tsalle ce. 2020, 2024, da 2028 duk shekarun tsalle ne. Saboda haka wannan ƙa’ida daidai take koyaushe!”

y-m-80-06.s.s3.prompt: Bisa ƙa'idodin sama, jimillar shekarun tsalle nawa ne a cikin shekaru 400 (misali, daga 1601 zuwa 2000)? Da wannan ƙima, tsawon matsakaicin shekara shi ne kwanaki 365 + (adadin shekarun tsalle ÷ 400). (Idan ka yi amfani da ƙa'idar Jia kaɗai, za a sami 100 a cikin shekaru 400.)
y-m-80-06.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo adadin ninkin 4, ninkin 100, da ninkin 400 a cikin shekaru 400.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.hint.1: Yi amfani da ƙa'idodi ① zuwa ③ a jere sannan ka rubuta furuci mai haɗa da rage ƙididdigeya.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.r.a: Wannan shi ne sakamakon ƙirga duk ninkin 4 a matsayin shekarun tsalle. Dole ne a cire ninkin 100 a matsayin shekarun gama-gari.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.r.b: Ka lissafa ta hanyar cire ninkin 100 daga ninkin 4, sannan ka sake ƙara ninkin 400.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.r.c: Ka cire ninkin 100 a matsayin shekarun gama-gari amma ba ka yi la'akari da cewa ninkin 400 suna sake zama shekarun tsalle ba.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.r.d: Ka bar ninkin 400 a matsayin shekarun gama-gari ma, sannan ka sake cire su.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.explain: A cikin shekaru 400, akwai ninkin 4 guda 100, daga cikinsu 4 ninkin 100 ne (kuma 1 daga cikinsu ninkin 400 ne). 100−4+1=97. Matsakaicin shekara 365+97/400=365.2425 days ne, ya fi kusantar ainihin kusan 365.2422 days fiye da ƙa'idar Jia (365.25 days).

y-m-80-08.title: Yaya za a yi takarda da ke riƙe da siffarta idan aka yanke ta rabin?
y-m-80-08.topic: Girman takardar kwafi (jerin A) da murabba'ai masu kama da ita
y-m-80-08.goal: San cewa domin takarda ta zama mai kama da siffarta bayan an yanke ta rabi, rabon dogon gefe zuwa gajeren gefe dole ya tsaya iri ɗaya; tsara girma na integers da dama da suka cika sharadin kusan, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba zai yiwu daidai ba.
y-m-80-08.material:
An sani cewa idan aka yanke takardar kwafi A4 a tsakiyar dogon gefenta, tana zama A5 mai siffa iri ɗaya, kuma takardun A3 biyu suna da siffa iri ɗaya da takardar A2 guda. A nan 'siffa iri ɗaya' na nufin cewa murabba'ai biyun suna kama da juna, wato rabon dogon gefe zuwa gajeren gefe iri ɗaya ne. (Dogon gefe l da gajeren gefe w na murabba'i, mm)
Seojin ta yi tunani, "Idan aka yanke takardar hoto mai siffar 3:2 rabi, ba za ta riƙe siffarta iri ɗaya ba?"
y-m-80-08.thinking.1: Tsara girma da dama bisa sharadin kusantar ƙima
y-m-80-08.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa ƙima daidai ba zai yiwu ba
y-m-80-08.prereq.0: Rabon ɓangarori masu dacewa a siffofi masu kama
y-m-80-08.prereq.1: Ma'anar lambobin marasa-rabo (ba za a iya rubuta √2 a matsayin fraction ba)
y-m-80-08.s.s1.prompt: Wanne daga cikin takardun nan zai zama murabba'i mai kama da asalin takarda idan aka yanke dogon gefenta rabi? (Yi watsi da kurakurai a ƙasa da decimal point.)
y-m-80-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, rubuta dogon gefe da gajeren gefen ɓangaren da aka yanke rabi.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta dogon gefe ÷ gajeren gefe na kowace murabba'i da dogon gefe ÷ gajeren gefe na ɓangaren.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin siffar 3:2 za ta yi aiki ma. Rubuta faɗi da tsawon ɓangaren da aka yanke rabi, sannan ka kwatanta rabon.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi tunanin murabba'i mai ɗan bambanci kaɗan tsakanin faɗi da tsawo zai daidaita. Kwatanta shi da rabon ɓangaren da aka yanke.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani ya ɗauka cewa yanke yana da sauƙi idan dogon gefe ya ninka gajeren gefe sau 2. Ka yi tunanin siffar ɓangaren da aka yanke rabi.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani ya yi sassan sannan ya kwatanta rabon. Ɓangaren da aka yanke zai zama 177mm da 250mm, rabon biyun kuma kusan daidai ne.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.explain: Ga takarda mai dogon gefe l da gajeren gefe w, idan aka yanke l rabi, ɓangaren yana da dogon gefe w da gajeren gefe l/2. Domin su yi kama, ana buƙatar l/w = w/(l/2), saboda haka l² = 2w², wato l/w = √2 ≈ 1.414. Ga 250×354, 354/250 = 1.416, wanda yake kusa sosai da √2.
y-m-80-08.s.s2.prompt: Cikin takardu da dogon gefe l (mm) da gajeren gefe w (mm) dukkansu natural numbers ne kuma w daga 100 zuwa 500, ƙirƙiri girma 3 masu w daban-daban da kusan suke da siffa iri ɗaya ko da an yanke dogon gefen rabi. Ma'auni: l ya fi w tsawo, kuma l÷w yana cikin tazarar 0.007 daga √2 (kusan 1.41421).
y-m-80-08.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko yanke w guda ɗaya, lissafa kusan sau nawa na w ne l zai zama, sannan kusantar l zuwa integer.
y-m-80-08.s.s2.hint.1: Lissafa l÷w tare da l da w da ka zaɓa, sannan ka duba ko bambancin da √2 yana cikin 0.007.
y-m-80-08.s.s2.ok.c1: l da w natural numbers ne, kuma w yana cikin zangon.
y-m-80-08.s.s2.fail.c1: l da w dole su zama natural numbers, w kuma daga 100 zuwa 500.
y-m-80-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Dogon gefe ya fi gajeren gefe tsawo.
y-m-80-08.s.s2.fail.c2: l dole ya fi w tsawo.
y-m-80-08.s.s2.ok.c3: l÷w yana kusa da √2 yadda ya kamata.
y-m-80-08.s.s2.fail.c3: l÷w ya fi √2 nesa da 0.007. Ka lissafa rabon da kanka domin dubawa.
y-m-80-08.s.s2.explain: Da zarar ka yanke w, l yana tabbata kusa da w×1.414. Misali, idan w=210, to l≈297; idan w=297, to l≈420; idan w=100, to l≈141. Ta wannan hanya l guda ɗaya ne yake tabbatua ga kowane w, saboda haka za ka iya ƙirƙirar girma da yawa masu w daban-daban.
y-m-80-08.s.s3.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba za a iya yin takarda da l÷w daidai da √2 ba idan l da w natural numbers ne. Sannan ka yi hasashe cikin jimla ɗaya yadda wataƙila aka yanke ma'aunin gaske.
y-m-80-08.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta l÷w=√2, ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu murabba'i, sannan ka rubuta dangantakar l² da w².
y-m-80-08.s.s3.hint.1: Lissafa 297÷210, kwatanta shi da √2, sannan ka duba daga wane wurin decimal suka fara bambanta.
y-m-80-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka danganta da gaskiyar cewa ba za a iya rubuta √2 a matsayin rabon natural numbers biyu ba?
y-m-80-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka kuma rubuta abin da 'ba daidai ba' yake nufi (kuskuren ƙanƙanta ne sosai)?
y-m-80-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi hasashe mai ma'ana cewa wataƙila an yi amfani da zagaye a ma'aunin gaske?
y-m-80-08.s.s3.model.0: Domin ya zama daidai ninkin √2, l÷w dole ya zama √2, amma √2 lamba ce marar-rabo kuma ba za a iya rubuta ta a matsayin fraction na natural numbers biyu ba. Saboda haka ba zai zama daidai da integers na mm ba; an yi amfani da kusantar ƙima mai kuskure ƙanƙanta sosai, kamar 297÷210.
y-m-80-08.s.s3.model.1: Idan l da w natural numbers ne, l÷w fraction ne, amma √2 lamba ce marar-rabo da ba za a iya rubuta a matsayin fraction ba, saboda haka ba za su yi daidai ba. Ina ganin an zagaye ma'aunin domin ya dace da mm. Ba cikakken daidaito ba ne, amma kuskuren yana da ƙanƙanta sosai.

y-m-80-09.title: Idan akwai lambar tantancewa, za ta iya gano kowane kuskuren rubutu?
y-m-80-09.topic: Lambar tantancewa ta lambar littafi (ISBN) da gano kurakurai
y-m-80-09.goal: Bincika da misalai irin kuskuren shigarwa da lambar tantancewa take ganowa tabbatacce da waɗanda za ta iya rasa, sannan ka bayyana iyakarta ta hanyar ƙirƙirar misalin da za ta rasa da kanka.
y-m-80-09.material:
Lambar Littafi ta Ƙasa da Ƙasa (ISBN-13) da ke bayan murfin littafi tana da lambobi 13. Ninka lambobi 12 na farko a jere da 1, 3, 1, 3, ... sannan tara su gaba ɗaya a sami S; lamba ta 13 (lambar tantancewa) ita ce lambobi 0 zuwa 9 da idan aka ƙara wa S jimillar ta zama ninkin 10.
Misali (lamba da aka ƙirƙira): idan lambobi 12 na farko su ne 9 7 8 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9, to S = 9×1+7×3+8×1+1×3+2×1+3×3+4×1+5×3+6×1+7×3+8×1+9×3 = 133, kuma lambar tantancewa ita ce 7 (133+7=140).
Seojin ta ce, "Tun da akwai lambar tantancewa, idan ka rubuta lambar ba daidai ba, za ta iya gano kowane kuskure!"
y-m-80-09.thinking.0: Gwada ƙa'ida da misalai domin tantance ikirarin gaba ɗaya
y-m-80-09.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri da kanka yanayin kurakuran da za ta rasa (misalan ƙaryatawa)

y-m-80-09.s.s1.prompt: Yaya za ka yanke hukunci kan maganar Seojin da bayanin da kake da shi yanzu? (Kuskuren shigarwa na iya zama canza lamba guda zuwa wata lamba, ko musanya jeri na lambobi biyu maƙwabta.)
y-m-80-09.s.s1.hint.0: A lambar misali, canza lamba guda (misali, 8 a matsayi na 3) zuwa wata lamba daban sannan ka lissafa yadda jimillar nauyi ta canza.
y-m-80-09.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada yadda jimillar nauyi take canzawa idan ka musanya jerin lambobi biyu maƙwabta.
y-m-80-09.s.s1.o.a: Ana gano kuskuren lamba guda, amma dole ne a gwada sauran nau'in kuskure dabam-dabam.
y-m-80-09.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tunani ne na raba kurakurai zuwa nau'o'i sannan a gwada kowanne.
y-m-80-09.s.s1.o.b: Hakan daidai ne. Idan akwai lambar tantancewa, za ka iya cewa tabbas tana gano kowane kuskuren shigarwa.
y-m-80-09.s.s1.r.b: Ka ɗauki kasancewar lambar tantancewa a matsayin garanti na hana dukkan kurakurai.
y-m-80-09.s.s1.o.c: Ba daidai ba ne. Lambar tantancewa lamba guda ce kawai, saboda haka mu ce ba za ta iya gano kowane kuskure ba.
y-m-80-09.s.s1.r.c: Ka raina aikin lambar tantancewa. A zahiri ka gwada ko ana gano kuskuren lamba guda.
y-m-80-09.s.s1.o.d: Ba zan iya sani ba. Ƙa'idar tantancewa ta bambanta daga littafi zuwa littafi, saboda haka ba za a yanke hukunci gaba ɗaya ba.
y-m-80-09.s.s1.r.d: A wannan aiki ƙa'idar ta tabbata. Ka manta cewa za ka iya lissafa ta bisa ƙa'idar da aka bayar.
y-m-80-09.s.s1.explain: A matsayi mai nauyi 1 ko 3, idan lamba guda ta bambanta da e, jimillar nauyi tana canzawa da 1×e ko 3×e, kuma wannan ba zai taɓa zama ninkin 10 ba idan e yana daga 1 zuwa 9. Saboda haka ana gano kuskuren lamba guda koyaushe. Amma dole ne a gwada dabam kuskuren da lambobi biyu suka canza tare.
y-m-80-09.s.s2.prompt: A ɗauka cewa lambobi a matsayi biyu maƙwabta su ne x (matsayi mai nauyi 1) da y (matsayi mai nauyi 3). Idan x da y sun bambanta, nemo ma'aurata 3 daban-daban inda musanya matsayinsu ke ba da jimillar nauyi mai ragowa iri ɗaya (don haka tantancewar ba ta ganowa).
y-m-80-09.s.s2.hint.0: Ka lissafa da kanka bambancin jimillar nauyi x×1+y×3 da y×1+x×3 kafin da bayan musanya jeri.
y-m-80-09.s.s2.hint.1: Gwada wasu ma'aurata ƙanana, tattara yanayin da bambancin yake ninkin 10, sannan ka nemo ƙa'idar.
y-m-80-09.s.s2.fail.c1: x da y dole su zama lambobi guda ɗaya daga 0 zuwa 9.
y-m-80-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Lambobin biyu sun bambanta, saboda haka musanya su yana canza lambar.
y-m-80-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan lambobin biyu iri ɗaya ne, musanya su ba ya canza lambar. Yi amfani da lambobi daban-daban.
y-m-80-09.s.s2.ok.c3: Ko da an musanya jeri, bambancin jimillar nauyi ninkin 10 ne, saboda haka tantancewar ba ta ganowa.
y-m-80-09.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan aka musanya jeri, jimillar da aka auna tana canzawa da ƙima da ba ninki 10 ba, don haka binciken yana gano kuskuren.
y-m-80-09.s.s2.explain: Bambancin x×1+y×3 da y×1+x×3 shi ne 2(y−x). Domin wannan ya zama ninki 10, dole ne y−x ya zama ninki 5; idan x≠y, nau’i-nau’in da suka dace su ne inda lambobin suka bambanta da 5 (0 da 5, 1 da 6, 2 da 7, 3 da 8, 4 da 9).
y-m-80-09.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta abin da za ka gaya wa Seojin. Ka bayyana irin kuskuren da lambar bincike take ganowa da wanda za ta iya kasa ganowa, ta amfani da nau’in lambobi biyun da ka samo yanzu a matsayin misali.
y-m-80-09.s.s3.hint.0: Saka nau’in lambobin da ka samo yanzu cikin lamba, musanya jerinsu, sannan ka nemo lambar bincike ta sabuwar lambar.
y-m-80-09.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta ko lambobin bincike na lambobin biyun iri ɗaya ne, sannan ka rubuta ƙarshe.
y-m-80-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka tabbatar da lissafi cewa nau’in lambobin da na bayar da gaske ba a gano kuskurensa?
y-m-80-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bambanta cewa ana gano kuskuren lamba guda, amma musanya jeri na iya kubuta?
y-m-80-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana a sarari cewa “ba cikakkiyar garanti ba ce” domin kada Seojin ta ruɗu?

y-m-80-09.s.s3.model.1: A’a. Idan aka musanya 2 da 7 da ke kusa, jimillar da aka auna tana canzawa da ninki 10 kawai, don haka lambar bincike ba ta canzawa. Saboda haka yana gano kuskuren lamba guda amma yana iya kasa gano kuskuren musanya jeri.

y-m-80-10.title: Za mu iya yarda cewa waɗannan sandunan yut suna da adalci?
y-m-80-10.topic: Yiwuwa sakamakon wasan yutnori da kwatanta samfura
y-m-80-10.goal: Lissafta yiwuwar sakamakon yutnori ta amfani da samfuri da sandunan yut suke zaman kansu, kuma yiwuwar gefen lebur ya bayyana ita ce 1/2; tantance yadda bayanan jefawa na gaske suka dace da wannan samfurin ta hanyar kwatanta shi da wani samfuri, sannan ka bayyana iyakokin shaidar.
y-m-80-10.material: A wasan yutnori, ana jefa sandunan yut 4, sakamakon kuma yana dogara da adadin gefuna lebur (배) da suka fuskanci sama: gefuna lebur 0 = 모, 1 = 도, 2 = 개, 3 = 걸, 4 = 윷. Bari p ya zama yiwuwar gefen lebur (배) ya fuskanci sama idan an jefa sanda guda, sannan a ɗauka sanduna huɗun ba sa shafar juna.

y-m-80-10.s.s1.hint.0: Ka kira sandunan ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, sannan ka rubuta duk hanyoyin zaɓar sanda 2 da za su nuna gefen lebur (배).
y-m-80-10.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko nemo jimillar duk haɗuwar gefen lebur/baya (배/등), sannan ka kwatanta da adadin lokutan da gefuna lebur suka zama 2.
y-m-80-10.s.s1.o.a: 1/5 (sakamako biyar ɗin suna da yiwuwar daidai)
y-m-80-10.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa tunda akwai sakamako biyar, duk suna da yiwuwar iri ɗaya. Adadin hanyoyin samun kowane sakamako ya bambanta.

y-m-80-10.s.s1.explain: Haɗuwar lebur/baya ta sanduna huɗun ita ce 2×2×2×2=16, kuma duk suna da yiwuwar daidai. Lokutan samun gefuna lebur 2 guda 6 ne, wato hanyoyin zaɓar sanduna 2 daga cikin 4; saboda haka 6/16=3/8. (모 1/16, 도 4/16, 개 6/16, 걸 4/16, 윷 1/16)
y-m-80-10.s.s2.prompt: Yayin duba bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya, tantance ko samfurin A ya dace da ainihin sandunan yut.

y-m-80-10.s.s2.st.0.info: Sakamakon samfurin A (p=1/2): 모 1/16, 도 4/16, 개 6/16, 걸 4/16, 윷 1/16. Idan aka jefa sau 80, adadin da ake sa ran samu shi ne 모 5, 도 20, 개 30, 걸 20, 윷 5.
y-m-80-10.s.s2.st.0.ask: Cikin sakamakon jefawa 80, idan 윷 bai fito daidai sau 5 ba, ya kamata mu ce samfurin A ba daidai ba ne?
